reason: The +17 bytes do not fit bank 4 in the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW build, which is the gate's oracle: applied to a clean copy of HEAD, `make DEFINES=DEBUG_FULLREDRAW` fails with 'src/main.6502:151: error: bank 4 overruns the renderer's workspace by 10'. In that build bank 4 ends at &B3F9, only 7 bytes below REN_BASE &B400 (build/strykers-debug_lives-debug_fullredraw.lst). The candidate checked only ASSERT render_end <= REN_BASE and missed main.6502's ASSERT * <= REN_BASE at the end of bank 4. The shipping build (&B37D, 131 bytes free) and the gameplay build still assemble. Everything else holds. All opcodes are real 65SC12 ones: BRA, LDX abs, LDA zp,X. The new loop sits inside page &92 (&92D9-&92FC) and every branch is in range. act is &BC6E-&BC8F, so act,Y never crosses a page. take_off with need bit 7 clear is exactly LDA need,X (4) / BPL out (3) / RTS (6). A skipped entry costs 36 cycles old (DEY 2, STY zp 3, LDX abs,Y 4, BEQ 2, JSR 6, 4+3+6, LDY zp 3, BNE 3) and 15 new (DEY 2, BEQ 2, LDX abs,Y 4, LDA zp,X 4, BPL 3), so it saves 21. Only classify writes act (X ascending), so slot 0 can only be at index 0. ren_k is never read before it is next written. No self-modified operand is in the window.
